root_idea.summary: The root centers on relaxation or loss of firmness in something.
root_idea.development: Its semantic development extends from a slit or rent and a loosened bond to weakness, unsoundness, and frailty.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized masculine singular active-participial citation form وَاهٍ.

senses.definition: Frail, weakened, or loosened; lacking firmness or structural soundness.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is the feminine form وَاهِيَةٌ, describing the sky as having lost its firmness in the setting of its splitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become greatly slit, rent, or torn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb describing the development of a slit or rent in something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become lax, flaccid, uncompact, unsound, or weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb used of a rope or other thing, and figuratively of an affair or case entering a weak or unsound state.
A separately reported use of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slit or rent in leather, cloth, or a similar material.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal lexical use for a break or opening in a flexible material.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Verb meaning of becoming slit or rent.
Weakening or loosening branch plus the separately reported falling use.
Uncompact, unsound, and weak states are covered by the broader weakening meaning.
Application to an affair or case is covered by the weak or unsound state meaning.
Adjectival branch of laxness, weakness, frailty, and lack of firmness.
Pointer-only cross-reference with no additional lexical content.

cautions: The public headword is normalized to the masculine singular citation form وَاهٍ; the Quranic occurrence itself is feminine وَاهِيَةٌ. The reported Classical verb meaning “to fall” is not assigned to the Quranic adjective.
